## 更新内容 / Changes

- 创建实例统一为先选择 Codex 或 Claude，再选择桌面应用或 CLI 终端；保留已有实例的启动方式和隔离目录边界。
- 模型、API 协议和认证方式改为按密钥保存。同一供应商的不同密钥可分别配置 OpenAI Responses、Chat Completions 或 Anthropic Messages，以及不同模型目录。
- 接口测试按每把密钥选择模型和协议，移除固定 GPT 模型。模型获取支持 Anthropic 分页，代理请求支持其必需的认证头。
- 模型编辑新增“全部清除”；清除已选模型后保留 API 获取结果，可直接“全部加入”。测试结果中的模型保存只更新当前密钥。
- 兼容旧供应商目录、备份和导入。已有独立连接保持自己的配置；在创建实例时发现其模型与密钥不一致，需要明确关联后才应用密钥配置。

- Instance creation now starts with Codex or Claude, followed by desktop application or CLI terminal. Existing launch modes and profile boundaries are preserved.
- Models, API protocol and authentication are stored per key. Keys from one supplier can have different model catalogues and use OpenAI Responses, Chat Completions or Anthropic Messages.
- Connection tests select a model and protocol for each key without a fixed GPT model. Model discovery supports Anthropic pagination, and proxy requests allow its required authentication headers.
- Model editors include Clear all while retaining fetched results for Add all. Saving discovered models updates only the selected key.
- Legacy supplier catalogues, backups and imports remain compatible. Standalone connections retain their own configuration; the instance wizard requires explicit linking before applying a different key catalogue.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。有运行实例时，关闭窗口或普通退出会保留后台服务；请完成任务、等待实例结束且管理器彻底退出后再安装新版。账号、实例、会话与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未完成验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Closing the window or using ordinary Quit keeps background services alive while instances are running. Finish active work and wait for the instances and manager to exit completely before installing an update. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

支持 Codex 桌面 / CLI、macOS Claude Desktop 的独立实例和客户端内登录，以及 macOS 官方原生 Claude Code CLI 的 API Key、Bearer 和兼容 Anthropic Messages 网关连接；客户端需单独安装。Claude 订阅账号可在账号页添加、刷新身份和用量，其 Claude Code OAuth 范围不能替代 Desktop 登录，受管 CLI 的订阅凭据启动尚未接入。云模式和 npm 包装启动器仍未接入。

Desktop 分别保存实例 Cookie、配置、加密状态文件与本地历史，共用当前 macOS 用户的系统钥匙串服务；同账号的云端历史仍可同步。Desktop 遵循管理器设置中的默认网络（代理、直连或继承），Code 用户自定义环境可覆盖默认网络。Desktop 会话在客户端中管理，管理器暂不索引或迁移；CLI 会话管理只读。Codex 菜单和语言适配取决于客户端版本，Fast / Ultra 还取决于模型和服务商。

Codex desktop / CLI, independent Claude Desktop instances on macOS with sign-in inside the client, and the official native Claude Code CLI on macOS are supported. CLI connections use API Keys, Bearer tokens or gateways compatible with Anthropic Messages. Install clients separately. Claude subscription accounts can be added and refreshed for identity and usage; their Claude Code OAuth scopes do not replace Desktop sign-in, and subscription credentials are not integrated into managed CLI launches. Cloud modes and npm wrapper launchers remain unintegrated.

Desktop instances keep separate cookies, configuration, encrypted state files and local history while sharing the current macOS user's system Keychain service. Cloud history for the same account can still sync. Desktop follows the default network in manager Settings (proxy, direct or inherit); custom Code environments can override that default. Manage Desktop sessions inside the client; the manager does not index or migrate them. CLI session management is read-only. Codex menu and language integration depends on the client version; Fast / Ultra also depend on the model and provider.

## 验证来源 / Verification

本轮验证包括真实管理器界面的客户端选择、供应商与密钥编辑、模型批量操作和接口测试，以及密钥配置投影、旧数据迁移、备份、取消与过期状态、源码和 Go 回归。协议和模型请求使用本机模拟服务及隔离测试凭据验证，覆盖不同模型 ID、OpenAI / Anthropic 认证和配置代理。打包验收检查应用启动与显示版本。本轮没有执行真实付费模型请求或真实账号 Desktop 登录；Desktop 的启动、目录与代理能力沿用上一版本已验证的边界。

Validation covers client selection in the running manager UI, supplier and key editing, model bulk actions, connection tests, linked configuration, migration, backups, cancellation, stale revisions, and source / Go regression tests. Local mock services and isolated credentials verify different model IDs, OpenAI / Anthropic authentication and configured proxies. Packaged acceptance checks application launch and the displayed version. This release does not claim real paid model requests or real-account Desktop sign-in; Desktop launch, profile and proxy support retain the boundaries verified in the preceding release.
